main_text.l: Accuratior erat, quæ ex āuicularum sanguine,
aqua viua, ligno cedrino, musco, dibapho coccineo,
Huius pur- { Debita materiæ præpa- } Leu.14.5.6.
nis mem- { Eius applicatio ad pur- { 7.51.52.
per idoneū iugulatæ sanguis infūdatur in vas testaceū,
super aquā viuā tum auiculam viuam cū reliquis ac-
ceptam, simul intingat aliquis in iugulatæ sangui-
sine humanitatis sanguine ad purgationem profutu-
ram: neq; sanguinem(nisi dei vita fuisset viuifica) ad
expiatione vnquam futurum fuisse idoneum, Ioh.6.
Secundum est viuæ dimissio extra ciuitatem in
te, sibi obedientibus esse in æternū authore salutis.

page.notes: The brace-group at lower right is set in a bracket structure; the last lines are cut off at the bottom of this part. Some words in the running lines are doubtful, notably "aqua viua" and "cedrino", and the mark "y" in the text is not clearly legible. Right margin strip shows only fragments of note text (e.g. "t", "r", "n", "ris", "fu", "cia", "ant", "mil", "&") too cut off to transcribe reliably. Several words in the first lines are uncertain due to the cut at the top.
